# Test isolation

<!-- generated by mem. write through `mem remember`, never by hand. -->

- <!-- mem {"id":135,"kind":"gotcha","confidence":0.9,"provenance":"writecam/tests/tst_writecam.cpp (shortcutReferenceFitsTheWindow); writecam/src/Main.qml (alternativesPanelVisible)","topic":"test-isolation","version":1} --> In writecam, the alternatives panel's visibility must use unscaled `width >= 640`, not `scaledSize(640)`. tests/tst_writecam.cpp's shortcutReferenceFitsTheWindow(large-text) persists desktopTextScale=3 in QSettings, so later Backend instances inherit a large textScale and hide the panel; editsAlternativeVersionsInThePanel and movesThroughThePanelRowsWithoutWrapping then fail.
